source.title: Ashenvale Mission III: Defeat Dragonkin
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Forest Song. Defeat dragonkin there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat 3 Wyrmkin Nightstalkers and 10 Terror Whelps in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursion in Forest Song and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
